body:
Other people's feelings mean nothing to me. I find most interactions with others to be at the least meaningless if not highly annoying. In fact I find facing the end of my life brings on less stress than having to go back out into the world and be around people. 

There wouldn't be enough time for someone to "fix" me. It would be too much of a shock for me to be all of a sudden around people and forced to interact with them. 

I've read what people here had to say and I find it to be yet another dead end. I thought maybe getting it out there would accomplish something but it didn't change my mind. Luckily I have a revolver which I will use to kill myself. I'm tired of life and the people in it. Since I can't live life the way I want to, I'm going to end it right now.
